notes: *Lay* is added under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause because the last clause writes no verb at all; the two *thy* are added under rule 18's closing sentence, since יָד and פֶּה carry no suffix.
*evil* is kept with זַמּוֹתָ as part of the verb's own rendering under rule 44; marking it added as a supplied object noun is the competing reading and is recorded in the unit note.
